A separate take-out/delivery a la carte menu (Fresh Meat Items sold individually, Bento Boxes, Family Meal, Side Dishes, Drinks) IS fully priced and cross-checked matching across DoorDash and Grubhub (e.g. Bulgogi $15.99, Manna Galbi $23.99 identical on both) - but that a la carte channel is not the restaurant's core AYCE offering. Per standing rule, when the core offering is unpriced, block rather than file a menu of only the priced sections.
